name: Lawless
description: No central authority. Free ports, pirate havens, uncharted outposts.

name: Frontier
description: Basic trade laws. Local marshals, voluntary cargo manifests.

name: Standard
description: Port authority, police customs. Regular inspections.

name: Security State
description: Military checkpoints, biometric registry, import permits required.

name: Lockdown
description: Police state, quarantine, occupation. Total control of movement and goods.
